visible_text:
To: Students
From: Campus Services
Facilities will be testing the water lines at the library café this
afternoon, so service will end earlier than usual. If you have
a study group—no problem! The dining area will remain
open, and you’re welcome to bring outside food and drink.
Please tidy up your table before leaving.
